instruction: Speak in Korean. Before speaking, clear your throat to signal you are about to say something important.
text: 지금부터 시상식을 시작하겠습니다. 첫 번째 수상자를 발표하겠습니다.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The speaker clearly clears their throat before beginning to speak, perfectly fulfilling the instruction.

instruction_evidence.implicit_nv: A distinct and intentional throat-clearing sound is heard.
instruction_evidence.placement: The throat clearing is perfectly placed right at the beginning of the audio, before any speech starts.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The throat clearing sounds genuine, and the transition into speech is very natural.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The throat clearing effectively sets an authoritative and formal tone, well-suited for the award ceremony announcement.

instruction: Speak in Korean. Take an audible, quick breath right before the main part of the warning to add a sense of urgency.
text: 시간이 없어, 어서 그 건물을 빠져나와야 해!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The speaker takes a very clear, audible, quick breath right at the beginning before delivering the warning, perfectly matching the instruction.

instruction_evidence.implicit_nv: A sharp, quick breath is clearly heard before the first word.
instruction_evidence.placement: The breath occurs right before the speech starts, effectively setting up the urgent warning.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The breath and the subsequent speech sound highly natural and contextually appropriate.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The quick gasp adds a strong sense of urgency, and the speech is delivered with convincing panic and intensity.

instruction: Speak in Korean. Begin speaking just after a quiet, amused chuckle.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio successfully starts with a clear, quiet chuckle before the spoken text, matching the instruction perfectly.

instruction_evidence.implicit_nv_existence: A clear chuckle is heard at the very beginning of the audio.
instruction_evidence.placement: The chuckle occurs exactly before the speaker begins the text, as requested.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The chuckle sounds organic and blends smoothly into natural-sounding speech.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The speaker maintains an appropriately amused and reflective tone throughout the utterance, enhancing the overall expression.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The hum sounds natural and transitions smoothly into the spoken thoughts.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is expressive, effectively conveying a contented and thoughtful mood that matches the text.

instruction: Speak in Korean. Begin with an audible sigh of relief before you start talking.

instruction: Speak in Korean. Speak in a very sleepy voice, with a yawn interrupting your speech.

instruction: Speak in Korean. In the middle of the sentence, give a small, dry cough as if your throat is a bit scratchy.

instruction: Speak in Korean. Your tone is formal, but you can't quite suppress a laugh that escapes as you're speaking.
text: 회의 중에 그런 농담을 하는 것은... 적절하지 않다고 생각합니다. 다시는 이런 일이 없도록 주의해주십시오.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The speaker clearly produces a stifled laugh/snort right before speaking and maintains a suppressed laughing tone during the first phrase, perfectly matching the instruction.

instruction_evidence.stifled_laugh: An audible escaping laugh occurs at the very beginning, and the voice trembles with suppressed amusement during the first half of the utterance before composing itself.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The transition from the suppressed laugh to the formal reprimand sounds completely natural and human-like.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The contrast between the formal text and the amused, stifled delivery is highly convincing and expressive.
